1031: One has come acting in ego and possessiveness,
led along bound by hope and desire.
ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ. ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ; ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Saying "mine, mine", what can one take along? One goes loaded with the poison and ashes of vice. ॥15॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
speak of the Indescribable, and the mind will merge in the Mind.
ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Restrain the restless mind and keep it in its own home; the Destroyer of pain will remove your pain. ॥16॥
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ; ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ ॥
One who has realised the shelter of the Lord and the Perfect Guru,
through the Guru knows loving attunement to the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
Nanak, through the Lord's Name the intellect is exalted; the Lord forgives and carries one across. ॥17॥4॥10॥
I have sought Your refuge, O Divine Guru;
You are all-powerful, merciful, Slayer of demons.
ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ; ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the Perfect Being, the Architect of destiny. ॥1॥
From the beginning, through the ages, You cherish all;
Your incomparable form is in every heart, O Merciful One.
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
As it pleases You, so You make all move; everything is done by You. ॥2॥
The sublime light of the Life of the world is within;
ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ ॥
He enjoys all hearts and drinks the Lord's essence.
ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ; ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
He Himself takes and He Himself gives; in the three worlds He is the Father of the world, the Giver. ॥3॥
Creating the world, He staged His play;
into air, water and fire He infused the soul.
ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ; ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The body-city has nine gates; the tenth is kept hidden. ॥4॥
There are four terrifying rivers of fire;
rare is the one who, through the Guru, understands, unattached through the Word.
ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਦਾਝਹਿ; ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
The faithless, in evil-mindedness, drown and burn; those whom the Guru protects are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥5॥
Water, fire, air, earth and sky —
ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ; ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
in the home of these five elements one dwells.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Those who remain dyed in love through the True Guru's Word renounce Maya, ego and doubt. ॥6॥
This mind is drenched and satisfied through the Word;
without the Name, what support can one lean on?
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਇਨਿ ਸਾਕਤਿ. ਦੂਤੁ, ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The thief within plunders the house and temple; this faithless one does not recognise the demon. ॥7॥
fiends, pull one this way and that.
ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ; ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Without awareness of the Word one comes and goes; one loses honour, coming and going. ॥8॥
Falsehood is salty earth; the body becomes a heap of ashes;
without the Name, what honour is yours?
ਬਾਧੇ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ, ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ; ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Bound, there is no liberation through the four ages; Death's messenger has marked you out. ॥9॥
Bound at Death's door, one receives punishment;
ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ; ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
He pleads and wails like a fish caught on the hook. ॥10॥
The faithless one is caught alone in the noose;
the blind one, under Death's power, is miserable.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ. ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Without the Lord's Name he sees no liberation; he wastes away today or tomorrow. ॥11॥
Without the True Guru there is no friend;
here and hereafter God alone is the protector.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਇਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
In mercy He gives the Lord's Name; thus water blends with water. ॥12॥
1032: The Guru instructs the disciple who has strayed,
and sets on the path one going into the wilderness.
ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Serve that Guru forever, day and night; he makes the Destroyer of pain your companion. ॥13॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
What do mortals know of devotion to the Guru?
Brahma, Indra and Shiva did not know it.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ. ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The True Guru is unseen; tell me, how can he be seen? Only one whom he forgives recognises him. ॥14॥
One with love within obtains the blessed vision;
one who loves the Guru's Word touches the Lord.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ; ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Day and night the immaculate Light is in all; through the Guru one knows the lamp within the heart. ॥15॥
Divine wisdom is food, the supremely sweet essence;
whoever has tasted it has seen the vision.
ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Beholding the vision, the detached are united; the mind, subduing desire, is absorbed. ॥16॥
Those who serve the True Guru are exalted;
ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
they recognise God within each and every heart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ, ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ; ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
Grant Nanak the Lord's praise and the company of the Lord's people, who have known the True Guru as the Lord God. ॥17॥5॥11॥
who formed the spheres of the earth with deliberation —
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ; ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
the Creator Himself creates and watches over all; the True One is carefree. ॥1॥
He created beings of many different kinds;
the two travellers set out on two paths.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ. ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Without the Perfect Guru there is no liberation; chanting the True Name is the profit. ॥2॥
ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ; ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
The self-willed read, but do not know the way;
they do not understand the Name and are led astray by doubt.
ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
They take bribes and give false witness; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ॥3॥
They read the Smritis, Shastras and Puranas,
argue and debate, but do not know the essence.
ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ. ਤਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Without the Perfect Guru the essence is not found; the true and pure walk the true path. ॥4॥
All praise Him, hearing and repeating what they hear;
He Himself, the Wise and True, tests them.
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Those on whom God casts His glance praise the Word through the Guru. ॥5॥
Hearing and hearing, so many speak the Word;
ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ; ਕੋ. ਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
hearing, they speak, but no one knows His limit.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One to whom the Unseen reveals Himself has the understanding to speak of the Indescribable. ॥6॥
At birth music plays and congratulations pour in;
the ignorant sing songs of joy.
ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ; ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Whoever is born must surely die; the hour is written on the head according to past deeds. ॥7॥
Union and separation were made by my God;
creating the world, He gave pain and pleasure.
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
The Guru-facing remain unattached to pain and pleasure, wearing the armour of humility. ॥8॥
Sublime are the traders in Truth;
through reflection on the Guru they buy the true merchandise.
ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
One who has the true merchandise and wealth in the lap is uplifted through the true Word. ॥9॥
the Guru-facing trade in what pleases God.
ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ; ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Their capital is intact, their stock secure, and Death's noose is cut. ॥10॥
1033: Everyone speaks as it pleases them;
the self-willed, in duality, do not know how to speak.
ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ; ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
The blind one's intellect is blind and deaf; coming and going, he suffers pain. ॥11॥
ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੈ; ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
In pain he is born, in pain he dies;
ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਮਿਟੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
without the Guru's refuge the pain is not erased.
ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੂਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ. ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
In pain he arises, in pain he perishes; what did he bring, and what will he take? ॥12॥
True action is to work under the Guru's authority;
then there is no coming and going, and no stream of Death.
ਡਾਲ ਛੋਡਿ. ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ; ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Leaving the branches, one has grasped the essential root, and true joy wells up in the mind. ॥13॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ; ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Death does not strike the Lord's people;
they see no pain on the hard road.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The Lord's Name and worship are within the heart; there is no other entanglement. ॥14॥
There is no end to Your praises, beautifully adorned;
as it pleases You, they abide in Your will.
ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Robed with honour they go easily to the court, by the command of the True Sovereign. ॥15॥
What can be said? Many speak of Your virtues;
even the greatest of the great do not find Your end.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
Nanak begs for the True One: preserve my honour; You are the Sovereign over kings. ॥16॥6॥12॥
Among cities and fortresses, the body is a city;
the True One dwells in the city of the tenth gate.
ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ. ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ; ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
His place is eternal, ever immaculate; He Himself creates Himself. ॥1॥
Within the fortress are balconies and markets;
He Himself buys and keeps the merchandise.
ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਜੜੇ ਜੜਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
He knows how to fix the heavy, rigid doors shut, and through the Guru's Word He has them opened. ॥2॥
Within the fortress is the cave, His dwelling place;
by His command the Sovereign of the will established the nine houses.
ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ; ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
In the tenth dwells the Primal Being, unaccountable and infinite; the Unseen reveals Himself. ॥3॥
Air, water and fire dwell together;
He Himself staged the play and the show.
ਬਲਦੀ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
The fire that by His grace is quenched by water, He Himself placed in the ocean. ॥4॥
He created the earth and established it as a place for practising righteousness;
He creates and destroys, yet remains unattached.
ਪਵਣੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ; ਕਲਾ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
He has set up the play of the breath everywhere; withdrawing His power, He brings it down. ॥5॥
All the vegetation of the world is Your flower-girl;
the wind, circling, waves the fly-whisk over You.
ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ. ਦੀਪਕ ਰਾਖੇ; ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
You have placed the moon and the sun as two lamps; the sun merges into the home of the moon. ॥6॥
The five birds do not fly off and run about;
the tree is fruitful, and they obtain the ambrosial fruit.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The Guru-facing one dwells in poise and sings His praises; He feeds him the food of the Lord's essence. ॥7॥
A glittering radiance shines that neither moon nor star,
nor sun's ray nor lightning in the sky can match.
ਅਕਥੀ ਕਥਉ. ਚਿਹਨੁ, ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
I describe the Indescribable, who has no sign or feature; He pervades all and is pleasing to the mind. ॥8॥
The ray of Divine Light spreads, and there is radiance;
the Merciful One Himself creates and beholds.
ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ, ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ. ਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
The sweet, unstruck melody ever resounds; one plays it in the home of the Fearless. ॥9॥
1034: The unstruck melody plays, and doubt and fear flee;
God pervades all, casting His shade over all.
ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ. ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
All is Yours; through the Guru You are known; singing Your praises one is beautified at Your door. ॥10॥
He is the Primal, Immaculate, Pure One;
ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
The One Universal Creator dwells in the mind and is pleasing to it, and ego and pride are cast off. ॥11॥
I have drunk the nectar the True Guru gave;
I know no second or third.
ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ; ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
He alone is the One, boundless and infinite; He tests and places one in His treasury. ॥12॥
Wisdom and meditation are in You, the True, deep and profound One;
ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
All that exists begs from You; one receives what is obtained by Your grace. ॥13॥
Good deeds and righteousness, the True Name, are in Your hands,
O Carefree Lord, in Your inexhaustible treasury.
ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
You are ever kind and merciful, O God; You Yourself unite in Your union. ॥14॥
He Himself sees, and He Himself shows;
He Himself establishes, He Himself disestablishes.
ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
The Creator Himself joins and separates; He Himself kills and revives. ॥15॥
All that exists is within You;
You Yourself watch over it, seated in Your eternal mansion.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
Nanak speaks the Truth and prays: in the Lord's vision peace is found. ॥16॥1॥13॥
I obtain Your vision if I am pleasing to You;
with loving devotion I sing the praises of the True One.
ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Those pleasing to You find You pleasing, O Creator; You Yourself put the taste on their tongues. ॥1॥
The devotees look beautiful in God's court;
Your servants, O Lord, are liberated.
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ. ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Erasing self-conceit they are imbued with Your love, meditating on the Name night and day. ॥2॥
Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You;
ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ; ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
celibates, the charitable and so many forest-dwellers — none finds Your end. ॥3॥
Unless He makes one know, no one knows;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
whatever He does, He does by His own will.
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ; ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
He created the 8.4 million species of beings, and by His will they draw breath. ॥4॥
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Whatever pleases Him surely comes to pass;
the self-willed show themselves off and weep.
ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Strayed from the Name, one finds no place, and suffers pain in coming and going. ॥5॥
Pure is the body, and radiant the swan-soul,
in which is the Name, a part of the Immaculate One.
ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵੈ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Such a one drinks all pains as nectar, and does not suffer pain again. ॥6॥
from indulgence comes disease, and in the end one is ruined.
ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ. ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਕਬਹੂ; ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Sorrow is never erased by joy; without His will one wanders in doubt. ॥7॥
Without wisdom the whole world wanders;
the True One pervades all, lovingly attuned.
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
One who knows the Fearless Word through the Guru, the True One, merges his light in the Light. ॥8॥
The Slayer of demons is eternal, unshakeable and immeasurable;
in an instant He tears down and rebuilds again.
ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
He has no form or feature, no measure or price; one pierced by the Word is satisfied in Him. ॥9॥
1035: I am the slave of the slaves of the Beloved,
the seekers of Truth, who reflect on the good.
ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ. ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ; ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
One who accepts the Name wins the game; He Himself implants Truth. ॥10॥
Those with Truth in their laps are true, of the True One;
the beloved Word is pleasing to the True One.
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
The True One infused His power and established the three worlds; one is satisfied in the True One alone. ॥11॥
Everyone calls Him great, the greatest;
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
without the Guru no one understands.
ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ; ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
One who merges in the True One is pleasing to the True One, and is not separated to suffer pain. ॥12॥
Those separated from the Primal Lord weep and wail;
they die and are born again as their time runs out.
ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ. ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਮੇਲਿ. ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Whomever He forgives He blesses with glory; united, one does not repent. ॥13॥
He Himself is the Creator, He Himself the enjoyer;
He Himself is satisfied, He Himself liberated.
ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ; ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
The Lord of liberation Himself grants the gift of liberation and dispels possessiveness and attachment. ॥14॥
Among gifts, the supreme gift is reflection on Him;
He is the all-powerful, infinite Cause of causes.
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ. ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ; ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
He creates and watches over His creation, and has people do the deeds to be done. ॥15॥
They sing His praises who are pleasing to the True One;
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ; ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
from You they arise, and into You they merge.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
Nanak speaks the Truth and prays: meeting the True One, peace is found. ॥16॥2॥14॥
For countless ages there was utter darkness;
there was no earth or sky, only the infinite command.
ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ. ਨ ਚੰਦੁ, ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
There was no day or night, no moon or sun; He sat in absolute trance. ॥1॥
ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ; ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
There were no sources of life or speech, no air or water,
no creation or destruction, no coming or going;
ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ; ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
no continents, underworlds or seven seas, and no water flowed in the rivers. ॥2॥
There was no heaven, this world or underworld then,
no hell or paradise, no death-dealing time;
ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ. ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
no hell or heaven, no birth or death; no one came or went. ॥3॥
There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva;
no other was seen; there was only the One.
ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
There was no woman or man, no caste or birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ॥4॥
There were then no celibates, the charitable or forest-dwellers;
there were then no Siddhas, seekers or householders living at ease;
ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
there were no yogis, wandering mendicants or religious garbs; no one was called a Master of yogis. ॥5॥
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
There was no chanting, austerity, self-discipline, fasting or worship;
no one spoke of any other.
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
He Himself created Himself and rejoiced; He Himself appraised Himself. ॥6॥
There was no purity, self-discipline or rosary of basil beads;
no milkmaids, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds;
ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
no tantras, mantras or hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ॥7॥
There were no rituals or religion, and no honey-sweet Maya;
no caste or birth was seen with the eyes;
ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
no net of possessiveness, no death hanging over the head; no one meditated on anyone. ॥8॥
ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ. ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
There was no slander or flattery, no soul or life;
there was then no Gorakh and no Machhindra;
ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
there was then no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no origin of clans, and no one counted his lineage. ॥9॥
1036: There were no castes or religious garbs, no Brahmins or Kshatriyas;
no gods or temples, no cows or Gayatri prayer;
ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
no burnt offerings or sacrificial feasts, no bathing at places of pilgrimage; no one performed worship. ॥10॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
There was no Mullah, no Qazi,
no Sheikh, no pilgrim to Mecca;
ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
no subjects or king, no worldly ego; no one spoke of such things. ॥11॥
ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ; ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti;
no friend or companion, no seed or blood.
ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ; ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
He Himself was the banker and He Himself the trader; such was the pleasure of the True One. ॥12॥
There were no Vedas or Semitic scriptures, no Smritis or Shastras;
no reading of Puranas, no sunrise or sunset.
ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
The Imperceptible One Himself was the speaker and preacher; the Unseen Himself revealed Himself. ॥13॥
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
When it pleased Him, He created the world;
without any support He held up the expanse.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, and increased the attachment to Maya. ॥14॥
To a rare few the Guru imparted the Word:
He creates and watches over all; His command is over all.
ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ; ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
He formed the continents, galaxies and underworlds, and from the hidden He became manifest. ॥15॥
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
this understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ; ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
Nanak, those imbued with the True One are wonder-struck; in wonder they sing His praises. ॥16॥3॥15॥
He created Himself and remains unattached;
the Merciful One made the true place.
ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ; ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Binding together air, water and fire, He fashioned the fortress of the body. ॥1॥
The Establisher established the nine houses;
in the tenth dwells the Unseen, Infinite One.
ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
The seven seas are filled with immaculate water; the Guru-facing are not stained with filth. ॥2॥
The sun and moon are lamps; His light is in all;
creating, He Himself beholds His glory.
ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
The Embodiment of light is ever the Giver of peace; through the True One one attains glory. ॥3॥
Within the fortress are markets and cities where trade goes on;
the trader weighs with perfect weights.
ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ; ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises it. ॥4॥
The Appraiser has appraised its worth;
the Carefree One's treasures are full.
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Holding all powers, He pervades all; through the Guru He makes a rare one understand. ॥5॥
When He casts His glance, one meets the Perfect Guru,
and the cruel messenger of Death does not strike.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ; ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
As the lotus blossoms in the water, so He Himself blossoms within and meditates. ॥6॥
He Himself rains down streams of nectar,
with jewels, gems and rubies beyond measure.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect One and obtains the treasure of love. ॥7॥
One who obtains the priceless treasure of love,
ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ; ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
whose weight never falls short, but is always full,
ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
becomes a trader in Truth and acquires the true merchandise. ॥8॥
Rare is the one who obtains the true merchandise;
the Perfect True Guru unites one with it.
1037: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
One who turns to the Guru recognises the command; accepting the command, one merges in Him. ॥9॥
By His command one comes, by His command one merges;
by His command the world is seen to be created.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
By His command are heaven, this world and the underworld; by His command His power sustains them. ॥10॥
By His command the earth is a load on the head of the mythical bull;
by His command are air, water and the sky;
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
by His command one dwells in the home of Shiva and Shakti, Maya; by His command He stages His plays. ॥11॥
By His command the skies are stretched out;
by His command He dwells in the waters, the lands and the three worlds;
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ; ਫੁਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
by His command one ever draws breath and receives food; by His command He watches and grants sight. ॥12॥
By His command He created the ten incarnations,
and countless, infinite gods and demons.
ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਝੈ; ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
One who obeys His command is robed with honour in the court, united with and merged in the True One. ॥13॥
By His command thirty-six ages passed;
by His command are Siddhas, seekers and contemplatives.
ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ. ਨਥਂ‍ੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਬਖਸੇ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
He Himself is the Master; all are bound by His nose-rope; whomever He forgives He liberates. ॥14॥
In the fortress of the body, within the citadel, is the King;
His deputies and attendants are there, and a beautiful gateway.
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਲਬਿ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
False greed does not let one dwell in His home; through greed and sin one repents. ॥15॥
In the city where truth and contentment are the officials,
with celibacy, truth and self-discipline one abides in the refuge of the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
Nanak, one meets the Life of the world in poise, and through the Guru's Word obtains honour. ॥16॥4॥16॥
The Infinite One established the power of the Absolute;
He Himself is unsupported, boundless and infinite.
ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ; ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
He Himself creates nature and beholds it; from the Absolute He fashions the Absolute. ॥1॥
From the Absolute He formed air and water;
creating the universe, He made the kings of the body-fortresses.
ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
In fire and water the soul is Your light; Your power rests in the Absolute. ॥2॥
From the Absolute He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva;
all the ages passed in the Absolute.
ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
One who reflects on this state is perfect; meeting such a one, doubt is dispelled. ॥3॥
From the Absolute He established the seven pools;
He who formed them Himself watches over them.
ਤਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
The mind of the Guru-facing that bathes in that pool of truth is not cast into the womb again. ॥4॥
From the Absolute came the moon, the sun and the skies;
His light pervades all the three worlds.
ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
The Unseen, Infinite, Unsupported One abides in the Absolute, absorbed in the trance of the Absolute. ॥5॥
From the Absolute He created the earth and the sky;
ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਰਾਖੇ; ਸਚੁ ਕਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
without pillars He supports them, exerting His true power.
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਜਿ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ; ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Forming the three worlds, He binds them with the belt of Maya; He Himself creates and destroys. ॥6॥
From the Absolute came the sources of life, from the Absolute speech;
from the Absolute it arose, and into the Absolute it merges.
ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ; ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
The supreme Creator staged the play of creation as vegetation springs from the earth; through His Word He shows this wonder. ॥7॥
From the Absolute He made both night and day;
creation and destruction, pleasure and pain He gave.
ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Beyond pleasure and pain, the Guru-facing become immortal and detached, and find their own home. ॥8॥
1038: The Sama Veda, Rig Veda, Yajur Veda and Atharva Veda,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
from Brahma's mouth, and Maya of three qualities —
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ; ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
no one can tell His worth; one speaks as He makes one speak. ॥9॥
From the Absolute He created the seven underworlds;
from the Absolute He fashioned the worlds and keeps them with loving care.
ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
The Infinite One Himself made the creation; all do what You have them do. ॥10॥
ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ; ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Rajas, tamas and sattva are Your shadow and power;
birth, death and the pain of ego You have given.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
One on whom the Lord shows mercy is liberated through the Guru in the fourth state. ॥11॥
From the Absolute the ten incarnations arose;
creating the universe, He spread out its expanse.
ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ; ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
He formed gods, demons, Shiva's attendants and celestial singers; all act according to what is written. ॥12॥
One who understands through the Guru is not afflicted with disease;
ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ; ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
rare is the one who knows this ladder of the Guru.
ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Through the ages it has been the support of liberation; one who is liberated attains honour. ॥13॥
From the Absolute the five elements became manifest;
joined in the body, one is engaged in deeds.
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ; ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Both bad and good are written on the forehead; one sows the seeds of sin and virtue. ॥14॥
Exalted are those who belong to the True Guru, the unattached Being;
imbued with the Word, they are intoxicated with the Lord's essence.
ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Spiritual powers, intellect and divine wisdom are obtained from the Guru; by perfect destiny he unites one with the Lord. ॥15॥
ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ; ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
This mind has great love for Maya;
let some wise one understand and settle it.
ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ; ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
In hope, desire, ego and anxiety, the greedy man practises falsehood. ॥16॥
One who obtains reflection from the True Guru
abides in the trance of the Absolute, in the true home.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ; ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
Nanak, the pure melody of the Word resounds within him, and he merges in the True Name of the Lord. ॥17॥5॥17॥
Wherever I look, there is the Merciful Lord of the meek;
the merciful God does not come or go.
ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ; ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
His way pervades all beings, yet the Sovereign remains unsupported. ॥1॥
ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
The world is the shadow of the One who has no father or mother,
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ, ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
no sister, no brother, no servant;
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ; ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
He has no birth or death, no lineage or caste; the Ageless, Supreme One is pleasing to the mind. ॥2॥
ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
You are the Timeless Being; death does not hang over Your head;
You are the Primal Being, unaccountable, unreachable, unattached.
ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Through truth and contentment and the Word one becomes very cool, lovingly attuned to You in poise. ॥3॥
Spreading the three qualities, He dwells in the fourth state;
birth and death He swallows in one mouthful.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
The immaculate Light, the Life of the whole world — the Guru has shown Him through the unstruck Word. ॥4॥
ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Sublime are the humble saints, good and beloved of the Lord;
intoxicated with the Lord's essence, they are carried across.
ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Nanak, in the dust of the saints and their company, by the Guru's grace one finds the Lord. ॥5॥
You are the Inner-knower; all beings are Yours;
1039: You are the Giver; we are Your servants.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ; ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
In mercy grant me the ambrosial Name; the Guru has lit the jewel of wisdom. ॥6॥
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ; ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Joining the five elements, this body was made;
finding the all-pervading Lord, one is at peace.
ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
One's deeds bear ambrosial fruit, and one finds the jewel of the Lord's Name in the mind. ॥7॥
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
One whose mind is reconciled has no hunger or thirst;
he knows the Immaculate One in each and every heart.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Imbued with the ambrosial essence alone, he is detached; through the Guru's teaching and love, his life is beautiful. ॥8॥
He does spiritual deeds day and night,
and knows the immaculate Light to be everywhere.
ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ; ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
His tongue savours the Word, the source of nectar; he plays the delightful flute. ॥9॥
He alone plays the delightful flute
who has understanding of the three worlds.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, learn this way through the Guru's teaching, and be lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥10॥
Such people are rare in the world,
who reflect on the Guru's Word and remain unattached.
ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ, ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
They cross over themselves, and carry across their generations and their companions; fruitful is their coming into the world. ॥11॥
That one knows the home, the door and the temple
ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
who receives understanding from the Perfect Guru.
ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ, ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
The body is the fortress and the mansion; God, the Master of the mansion, is true; the True One has set up His true throne. ॥12॥
ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ; ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
The fourteen realms and the two lamps bear witness;
His accepted servants do not taste the poison.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Within is the incomparable, priceless treasure; meeting the Guru, one obtains the Lord's wealth. ॥13॥
One worthy of the throne sits on the throne;
through the Guru's teaching the five senses are subdued and become his servants.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ. ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ; ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
He who was at the beginning, through the ages, is now and will be, dispels anxiety and doubt. ॥14॥
Such a one on the throne is saluted day and night;
ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
this is true glory, for one who knows loving attunement through the Guru's teaching.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
Nanak, chant the Lord and swim across; one finds the Lord, the companion at the end. ॥15॥1॥18॥
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ; ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Gather the wealth of the Lord, O brothers;
serve the True Guru and remain in his refuge.
ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
No thief or robber can touch it; the melody wells up, and the Word keeps one awake. ॥1॥
You are the One Universal Creator, the unsupported King;
ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ; ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
You Yourself arrange the affairs of Your servants.
ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Immortal, unshakeable, infinite and priceless, O Lord, You look beautiful in Your eternal place. ॥2॥
The body-city is a sublime place
where the five chosen ones dwell.
ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Above is the One Universal Creator, unsupported, absorbed in the trance of the Absolute. ॥3॥
the Creator fashioned them in each and every one.
ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ; ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
In the tenth is the Primal Being, detached and unattached; the Unseen reveals Himself. ॥4॥
The Primal Being is unaccountable; true is the court of the True One;
He runs all by His command; His insignia is true.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Nanak, search out your own home and find it; there you obtain the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ॥5॥
1040: The Immaculate One in all is the all-wise Being;
He dispenses justice; one absorbed in the Guru's wisdom
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ. ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
seizes lust and anger by the neck and kills them, and casts off ego and greed. ॥6॥
The Formless One dwells in the true place;
He Himself recognises and reflects on His command.
ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ; ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
One who dwells forever in the true mansion has his coming and going ended. ॥7॥
ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ, ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥
The mind does not waver, nor does the wind of desire blow it about;
the yogi plays the unstruck Word.
ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
The tinkling of the five instruments resounds, needing no support; God Himself plays it and makes one hear. ॥8॥
In the fear of God and in detachment one merges in poise;
renouncing ego, one is imbued with the Imperishable.
ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Applying the essence of the ointment, one knows the Immaculate, the Sovereign who keeps all immaculate. ॥9॥
God, the Destroyer of pain and fear, is imperishable;
He cuts away disease and the noose of Death.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, that Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, one finds the Lord God. ॥10॥
One who knows the Immaculate makes a morsel of death;
he understands His grace and recognises the Word.
ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ; ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
He Himself knows and recognises; all this is His wondrous play. ॥11॥
He Himself is the banker, He Himself the trader;
ਆਪੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
He Himself rubs on the touchstone, and He Himself appraises the worth. ॥12॥
When the Merciful God has shown mercy,
one knows that the Lord of the world pervades every heart.
ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
The Primal Being dwells detached and pure; through the Guru, the Being, one is united with the Supreme Being. ॥13॥
God, the all-wise and all-seeing, removes pride,
erases duality and reveals the One.
ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਨੀ; ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Amid hopes one remains free of hope, having sung of the Immaculate One, beyond birth and lineage. ॥14॥
Erasing ego, one finds peace through the Word;
one who reflects on oneself is truly wise.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
Nanak, the Lord's praise and the Lord's virtues are the profit; in the true congregation one obtains the true fruit. ॥15॥2॥19॥
Speak the Truth and dwell in the true home;
die while alive and cross the terrifying world-ocean.
ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ. ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ; ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The Guru is the ship, the boat, the raft; O mind, chant the Lord and be carried across. ॥1॥
The Name destroys ego, possessiveness and greed;
one is freed from the nine doors and has one's seat in the tenth.
ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰੈ. ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Above, beyond the beyond, is the Infinite One, who created Himself. ॥2॥
Take the Guru's teaching; lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over;
ਅਕਲੁ ਗਾਇ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ॥
singing of the Indivisible One, why fear Death?
ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ. ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Wherever I look, there I see only You; I sing of no other. ॥3॥
ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
True is the Lord's Name, true His refuge;
true is the Guru's Word, holding to which one crosses over.
ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ; ਫੁਨਿ. ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
One who speaks of the Indescribable beholds the Infinite, and does not enter the womb again. ॥4॥
ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Without Truth, one does not obtain truth and contentment;

without the Guru there is no liberation; one comes and goes.
